title: Puthoff says he consulted on the net assessment, with Hadley involved

tellings.quote: also Hal Putoff is on record saying he consulted for this net assessment. National security adviser Steven Hadley was involved

plain: Michels says the physicist Hal Puthoff is on record saying he consulted on a net assessment, a long-range strategic study of the kind the Pentagon commissions, that was under discussion on the show, and that the national security adviser Stephen Hadley was involved in it too. Michels tells this himself and does not say where Puthoff's statement appears. If true, it would place a figure from the UFO world inside a high-level government study in the 2000s.
